assessments.name: Continuous Ongoing Assessment
assessments.description: A series of short Canvas quizzes (4) and in-class worksheets (2).

assessments.name: Assign 1: Working with Legislation
assessments.description: Assignment 1 consists of 3 documents: (1) a File Note re. planning compliance; (2) a corresponding drawing mark up; (3) email communication of options to the client; all demonstrating professional judgement.

assessments.name: Assign 2: Contractor Selection & Contract Administration
assessments.description: Assignment 2 consists of 3 documents (1) contract analysis & communication with client; (2) material substitution analysis & communication with client; (3) site administration workshop (in-class); all requiring the demonstration of professional judgement.
